transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Since I watched that car get crushed in front of me last week, I’ve gone out of my way to avoid driving or even being near busy intersections. It was a horrific accident, and I just can't bring myself to get behind the wheel or be near traffic right now.
Since witnessing the accident, have you been having intrusive, unwanted memories or distressing dreams about the event?

Yes, I have. Out of nowhere, even when I’m just making coffee or looking at a spreadsheet, I’ll suddenly see that car flipping in vivid detail and my chest will clamp up. At night, I just lie there replaying the crash over and over in my head instead of falling asleep.
Since you witnessed the accident just last week, have you been experiencing these intrusive memories and avoidance symptoms for less than a month, or have they been persisting for longer than that?
It has only been about a week. Everything started in the days right after the crash last week, and it has been happening constantly since then.
Since the accident, have you felt like you are in a daze, or has it ever felt like the world around you is unreal or that you are detached from your own body?

No, I haven't really felt detached from my body or like the world is unreal. Instead, I feel highly alert and jumpy all the time, and my mind is just completely focused on avoiding any reminders of the crash.
